metadata.description: Official Claude Code plugin for TrailMark — the desktop Markdown IDE for planning, reviewing, and steering AI-written specs and docs.

plugins.name: trailmark
plugins.description: Read what your AI writes. Write what it reads. Connects Claude Code to TrailMark via MCP tools (get_context, search, list_tags, list_comments, resolve_comment, list_notes, read_note, list_unread, open) and automatic prompt context hooks.
